# Asset rights

The original Random Eras art in `blender/src/`, the art-authoring scripts, and the corresponding game exports in `public/` are all rights reserved by the Random Eras project owner. The owner approved that choice for the knight, equipment, scenery, and interface art.

Cinzel, Caveat and DM Sans retain their own SIL Open Font License terms. Their notices are in `public/fonts/`.
